name: Dredging
text: Your first dig each turn costs 1 less, never below 1.
notes: growth (Sluice until 2026-11-13: the second tide now lifts the starters' limit for everyone)

name: Scaffolding
text: Every site costs you 1 less (never below 1).

name: Barge
text: Pay one toll fewer on each build.

name: Reserve
text: For 1 pearl, set a display card aside: only you may buy it, and the display refills.

name: Diving
text: Your pearl threshold is 1 lower and you may hold 2 more pearls.

name: Relay
text: Board boost: with any Dig card, discard a Dig card for one more dig.

name: Tunnelling
text: You may dig a border between two crags; hills cost you nothing extra; your starting cards may dig in the highland.

name: Yard
text: Board boost: with any Build card, discard a Build card for one more build.

name: Second storey
text: You may build a second building on a hex where you have one.

name: Toll house
text: When a haul pays you, take 1 more from the bank, once per build.

name: Stone boats
text: Stone pays no toll to the bank.

name: Barter
text: Board boost: with any Buy card, discard an Earn card for 2 off.

name: Larder
text: Board boost: with any Earn card, 2 money per card discarded.

name: Survey
text: +1 hand size, up to the cap.

name: Lustre
text: A pearl is worth 3 money, or 2 off one dig, build or card.

name: Second wind
text: 3 pearls to play a second card this turn.
